issues: 工作台按 inline 推断只渲 104f，正好停在高亮那一刻，卡片要求的末段 ≥40f 真静止整段缺失
敲入的字符是两个深灰方块，候选行是灰色骨架条，读不出在搜什么、列表为什么收窄
压暗是中性灰 rgba(20,20,20,.45) 平铺，画面发闷；面板 2px 灰边 + 单层阴影，浮不起来
唤出没有动机：dashboard 静置 12f 后面板凭空出现；高亮只是灰底 + 4px 深灰左条
changes: 补导出 COMMAND_PALETTE_SUMMON_DURATION = 150（110f 后静止 40f），全部时间轴常量（压暗 12–22、弹落 18 −20→+8→0、4f 错峰、按键 62/78、高亮 94、闪烁到 104）不变
候选行换成真实命令（Invite people / Insert chart / Switch theme / New project / Export as PDF）+ 图标 + 快捷键键帽；输入 "i"→"in"，不匹配的行按原塌缩规则退场，保留行的匹配前缀加粗；底部提示栏随之显示 5→3→2 results
压暗改带色相的深色径向压暗 + 背景去饱和并后退 1.5%；面板改 1px 内外描边 + 顶部内高光 + 飞行级两层软阴影，弹落时 0.97→1 微缩放
开场画面底部出现 ⌘ K 键帽并在 10–16f 按下，给唤出一个因果；高亮改强调色浅底 + 3px 强调左条 + 图标转实色 + ↵ 键帽浮现；输入框加放大镜、占位提示、esc 键帽与强调色光标
issuesEn: The workbench's inline guess rendered only 104f, stopping right at the highlight, so the card's required ≥40f static ending was missing
Typed characters are two dark grey blocks and rows are grey skeleton bars, so you can't tell what is being searched or why the list narrows
The dim is a flat neutral grey rgba(20,20,20,.45) wash that muddies the frame; the panel has a 2px grey border and a single shadow, so it doesn't float
The summon has no cause: after 12f of idle dashboard the panel just appears; the highlight is a grey fill with a 4px dark left bar
changesEn: Added COMMAND_PALETTE_SUMMON_DURATION = 150 (40f of stillness after 110f); every timeline constant (dim 12–22, drop at 18 −20→+8→0, 4f stagger, keys at 62/78, highlight at 94, blink until 104) is unchanged

Rows are real commands (Invite people / Insert chart / Switch theme / New project / Export as PDF) with icons and shortcut keycaps; typing "i"→"in" collapses non-matching rows with the original rule while kept rows bold the matched prefix, and the footer counts 5→3→2 results

Dim is a hue-tinted dark radial overlay with the background desaturating and receding 1.5%; the panel gets 1px inner/outer strokes, a top highlight and a two-layer flight-level soft shadow, plus a 0.97→1 scale during the drop

A ⌘ K keycap pair appears at the bottom and presses at 10–16f to motivate the summon; the highlight is an accent tint with a 3px accent bar, a filled icon and a ↵ keycap; the input gets a magnifier, placeholder, esc keycap and accent caret
